title: Pattern captures never open a collapsed section, so half a sidebar is never photographed
foundBy: session agent, while updating the Explorer pattern for CUI-025
details:
`capturePatterns` clicks every expand-all control before it photographs a page, which expands the trees inside a section. It does not open a section that is collapsed, and SectionedTree keeps that state separately.

So the Explorer pattern's Dependencies section is never in a capture. Removing its filter box changed the rendered page and produced 0 differing pixels, confirmed by reverting the change and comparing both ways.

The fix is a few lines: click each section header whose control reports it collapsed, in the same place the expand-all clicks happen. It changes the baseline, so it wants its own pass rather than riding along with a content change.

notes.text: The same shape as the reason those captures expand trees at all: a pattern at rest hides the composition that is worth watching. This is the half of that argument the implementation missed.
